lines.en: Six legs push a round thing along.

lines.zh: 我滚的东西比我大一圈
lines.en: What I roll is a size bigger than me.
I push it uphill, straining.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我压出的两条线
lines.en: Two lines show where I passed.
I stop at the crest to rest.

lines.zh: 壳上的光泽在阳光下发亮
lines.en: My shell gleams in the sun.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把它摆正
lines.en: I straighten it as I walk.
Sand rolls off my back.
No need to hurry; push slowly.
My head presses its lower edge.
The higher the sun, the slower I go.
I shift forward step by step.
Fine sand coats my shell.
I am looking for a downhill route.
A day I can push is a good day.
I lie beside the round thing.
My wings are folded under the shell.
It is very sunny here; I do not mind.
I wait for it to cool.
There is a little wear on my shell.
The far sand looks bleached.
I wave my antennae slowly.
This thing has rolled a long way.
I am watching the wind.
The wind comes from behind.
I am reckoning how much farther.
I am under your shadow.
You stepped beside the ball I was rolling.
I lift my head, antennae first.

lines.zh: 你踩在我推的东西旁边
lines.en: You stepped beside what I push.
My shell is harder than your boot.
You are looking at the round thing.
I do not mind being watched.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在沙里看不清
lines.en: My eyes cannot see well in sand.
So we face each other.
I flip over, legs flailing.
A crack in my shell.
I drag myself along.
The round thing rolled off.
I stop to recover.
I burrow into the sand.
My legs still move.
Do not step on my shell.
I need a rest.

lines.zh: 我推的是圆东西，不是这口粮。
lines.en: I push round things, not this ration.
What I push is not food.
Put it down and let me smell.
Sweet? I do not much need it.
You put it too far away.
Let me look at it first.
This is not the kind I push.
I have gone around it.
You need not give me food.
I will go on pushing mine.

lines.zh: 我这层甲，磕一下就掉了。
lines.en: One knock chips this shell.
The round thing rolls away.
I turn immediately to chase it.

lines.zh: 你撞在我壳上，声音很闷
lines.en: You hit my shell with a dull knock.
I crawl back and push again.
My legs slip in the sand.
That flipped me over.
I claw at the sand to right myself.
Do not kick what I am pushing.
I move aside for you to pass.
We push different things.
There is not much food here.
I do not fight; I go around.
It is busy under the sun.
We keep to our own routes.
I need no one's help.
Pushing it that far is enough.
There are many companions in the sand.
We do not disturb each other.
Keep pushing.
It is lighter than my round thing.
I push it aside.
This will not roll.
I test it; it rolls well.
It is stuck in a rock gap.
I take another one instead.
This way is downhill.
I stop halfway.
I leave it behind.
I want to push this past you.
If you will not move, I go around.
The sand is soft; pushing is slow.
I turn my head toward you.
I dislike being blocked.
I have pushed this line for two days.
You are on the downhill side.
I will keep pushing.
Just move aside a little.
I cannot get through here.
My route has been cut.
I adjust my angle slowly.
You stand on my route.
I go around your feet.
My old tracks are in the sand.
My load is a bit crooked.
I need to set it straight.
You are uphill; I am downhill.
Wait; I will be past in a moment.
My legs are rather sore.
I keep pushing.
This path fits only one body.
I butt you with my head.
That had little force.

lines.zh: 我推的是圆东西，不是你
lines.en: I push the round thing, not you.
I bump you from the side.
That tipped me over too.
My shell is very hard.
I am guarding this round thing.
Do not kick it.
I start pushing again.
I crawl out of the sand.
The sun is right for pushing.
An old line runs across the sand.
I have found a round one.
I begin to push it.
There are not many here.
Sand still clings to my shell.
I test the direction.
Wind ripples the sand.
I work slowly uphill.
Fire heats my shell burning hot.
I tumble down, shell and legs.
Water rolls me and I cannot right myself.
The blast throws me into the air.
Something cracked my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我壳里发麻
lines.en: That force numbs me inside my shell.
Too hungry to push.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我腿都僵了
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and my legs lock.
There is no sand here to push.
